meta-description: Patrick Lessa - Senior Data Analyst specialized in Power BI, Python, and SQL. Over 5 years transforming data into strategic decisions.
hero-description: Over 5 years transforming raw data into C-level decisions for businesses and governments. Specialist in Power BI, Python, and SQL.
about-p1: I'm a Senior Data Analyst passionate about transforming complex data into actionable insights. With over 5 years of experience, I've been helping companies and government agencies make strategic data-driven decisions.
about-p2: Currently, I'm completing my PhD in Business Administration at UFSC, focusing on Data-Driven Marketing and market segmentation. I'm also the founder of Xplore Dados, a company dedicated to data intelligence and BI solutions.
about-p3: My key achievements include an 85% reduction in data preparation time, development of over 100 BI dashboards, and creation of solutions that impacted strategic decisions at a global level.
exp-mouts-1: Automated ingestion of 14 data sources (SharePoint and SQL), reducing manual preparation time from 6 hours to 45 minutes.
exp-mouts-2: Created executive dashboards that exposed critical risks in LATAM operations, driving strategic decisions within 30 days.
exp-mouts-3: Delivered Power Apps solutions with Power Automate automation, eliminating manual data entry errors.
exp-td-1: Led development of intelligence centers for strategic public agencies, including the Ministry of Education.
exp-td-2: Delivered over 100 BI dashboards for Stemmer Foundation (FEESC) across multiple institutional areas.
exp-td-3: Strategic data structuring for the Brazilian Space Agency.
exp-td-4: Created the Sebrae Startups Observatory, focusing on innovation ecosystem analysis.
exp-feesc-1: Supported identification, mapping, and monitoring of institutional processes.
exp-feesc-2: Developed strategic KPIs for the Distance Education (EaD) area.
exp-feesc-3: Structured and automated 10 manual spreadsheets, reducing time from weeks to days.
exp-informal-1: Conducted market research to identify trends and customer needs.
exp-informal-2: Developed marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
exp-informal-3: Created segmented campaigns based on data and market insights.
